title: Frontend Developer
short_description: Craft engaging, responsive user interfaces and interactive web experiences with modern frameworks.
description: Frontend Developers build the client-facing side of web applications. They translate UI/UX designs into fast, accessible, and interactive code using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React, Vue, or Next.js.
why_matches: You have a strong passion for visual aesthetics, interactive product experiences, and building things users can directly see and touch.
recommended_next_step: Take the Frontend Technical Readiness Test to evaluate your current HTML, CSS, and React foundations.

title: Backend Developer
short_description: Architect scalable APIs, microservices, databases, and core server-side business logic.
description: Backend Developers focus on server-side architecture, databases, application logic, and systems integration. They ensure data security, performance, and scalability across distributed infrastructure.
why_matches: You thrive on solving complex algorithmic problems, structuring data flows, and building reliable, high-performance backends.
recommended_next_step: Test your API design, database querying, and server-side logic in the Backend Skill Assessment.

title: Full Stack Developer
short_description: Master end-to-end product development spanning UI, server logic, databases, and deployment.
description: Full Stack Developers bridge client interfaces and server infrastructure. They deliver complete web solutions independently or lead cross-functional engineering teams.
why_matches: You enjoy the full product lifecycle from interactive UI design to database modeling and cloud deployment.
recommended_next_step: Take the Full Stack Readiness Test to pinpoint strengths across client and server layers.

title: Mobile App Developer
short_description: Build high-performance native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android.
description: Mobile Developers engineer fluid, touch-optimized applications for mobile platforms using React Native, Flutter, Swift, or Kotlin, optimizing for battery life, memory, and offline resilience.
why_matches: You enjoy crafting portable, gesture-driven experiences and utilizing native device hardware features.
recommended_next_step: Assess your mobile engineering readiness with the Mobile Developer Skill Test.

title: Data Analyst
short_description: Transform raw business data into actionable insights, dashboards, and strategic recommendations.
description: Data Analysts clean, inspect, model, and visualize data to empower business decision-making using SQL, Excel, Python, Power BI, and Tableau.
why_matches: You possess strong analytical acumen, love uncovering trends in data, and enjoy presenting visual stories.
recommended_next_step: Validate your SQL and analytical reasoning in the Data Analyst Readiness Test.

title: Data Scientist
short_description: Uncover hidden patterns and build predictive statistical models from complex datasets.
description: Data Scientists apply statistical methods, machine learning algorithms, and exploratory data analysis to solve complex analytical problems and forecast trends.
why_matches: You have a natural affinity for mathematics, statistical rigor, and using scientific methods to test hypotheses.
recommended_next_step: Test your statistics and modeling skills in the Data Scientist Skill Assessment.

title: AI/ML Engineer
short_description: Develop, train, fine-tune, and deploy deep learning models and generative AI systems.
description: AI/ML Engineers build intelligent software systems, computer vision models, LLM pipelines, and automated reasoning engines at production scale.
why_matches: You are enthusiastic about cutting-edge artificial intelligence, neural networks, and automating complex cognitive tasks.
recommended_next_step: Evaluate your Machine Learning fundamentals with the AI/ML Technical Readiness Test.

title: DevOps/Cloud Engineer
short_description: Automate CI/CD pipelines, manage cloud infrastructure, and maintain ultra-reliable systems.
description: DevOps and Cloud Engineers design reliable cloud architectures on AWS, GCP, or Azure, automate deployments with Terraform and Docker, and manage Kubernetes clusters.
why_matches: You enjoy automation, system resilience, networking, and orchestrating scalable cloud infrastructure.
recommended_next_step: Test your Linux, Docker, CI/CD, and Cloud knowledge in the DevOps Readiness Test.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
short_description: Protect systems, networks, and data from cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and attacks.
description: Cybersecurity Engineers secure applications, monitor networks for intrusions, perform vulnerability assessments, and implement zero-trust security postures.
why_matches: You have a defensive mindset, love finding vulnerabilities before attackers do, and care about digital safety.
recommended_next_step: Assess your security basics, networking, and cryptography with the Cybersecurity Test.

title: QA/Automation Engineer
short_description: Build automated test suites, stress testing pipelines, and guarantee high product quality.
description: QA Automation Engineers write automated end-to-end, integration, and load tests using tools like Playwright, Selenium, and Cypress to eliminate software defects.
why_matches: You have an eagle eye for detail, enjoy breaking edge cases, and love writing clean automated test harnesses.
recommended_next_step: Take the QA Automation Readiness Test to test your test design and assertion knowledge.

title: UI/UX Designer
short_description: Design intuitive user journeys, wireframes, interaction prototypes, and visual design systems.
description: UI/UX Designers conduct user research, create information architecture, craft interactive prototypes in Figma, and build cohesive design systems.
why_matches: You blend empathy, psychology, visual aesthetics, and usability to build software people love using.
recommended_next_step: Test your design principles, usability heuristics, and typography in the UI/UX Test.

title: Database/Data Engineer
short_description: Construct high-throughput data pipelines, data warehouses, and streaming architectures.
description: Data Engineers build scalable data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and data lakehouses using SQL, Python, Spark, Kafka, and Snowflake to fuel analytics and AI engines.
why_matches: You take satisfaction in building heavy-duty pipelines, organizing terabytes of information, and maintaining flawless data integrity.
recommended_next_step: Take the Data Engineering Readiness Test to test your database modeling and pipeline knowledge.
